senses.gloss: Pitānandin, n. of a yakṣa: Māy 〔44〕.
Pitāputrasamāgama (once Pitṛ-pu˚), m., n. of a work: Mvy 〔1333〕; Śikṣ 〔181.12〕; 〔244.11〕 (Pitṛ˚) = Bcṭ 〔326.24〕.
pitṛjña, father-honoring, see under mātṛjña, which regularly precedes this.
Pītaṅgalya, pl., n. of a people or region: Māy 〔42〕. See Lévi 〔93〕 (= Petirgala of Ptolemy, prob. modern Pitalkhora, near Chalisgaon, Khandesh).
